spans.claim: Benjamin H. Kyle was found dead with a fractured skull
spans.anchor: Kyle was lying on his face, his legs slightly drawn up
spans.span: Kyle was lying on his face, his legs slightly drawn up under him, and his arms reaching out and encircling the feet of a life-sized statue in the corner.

spans.claim: The statue of Sakhmet was the murder weapon
spans.anchor: That diorite statue, which killed Kyle, is Sakhmet
spans.span: … That diorite statue, which killed Kyle, is Sakhmet, the Egyptian goddess of vengeance--the destroying element.

spans.claim: The scarab pin belonged to Dr. Bliss and was found near the body
spans.anchor: That scarf-pin is the property of Doctor Bliss
spans.span: That scarf-pin is the property of Doctor Bliss.

spans.claim: Bliss’s fingerprints were found on the statue of Sakhmet
spans.anchor: Those are my finger-prints on that statue

spans.claim: Bliss’s tennis shoe made bloody footprints at the scene
spans.anchor: I found that shoe in the study, Mr. Markham
spans.span: I found that shoe in the study, Mr. Markham," Heath was saying.

spans.claim: Opium was found in the bottom of Bliss’s coffee cup
spans.anchor: There’s a slightly acrid odor here
spans.span: There's a slightly acrid odor here," he remarked.

spans.claim: The curtain of the cabinet was only half drawn with a loose ring
spans.anchor: the curtain of this cabinet is only half drawn
spans.span: that the curtain of this cabinet is only half drawn.

spans.claim: Vance’s experiment showed the statue could fall and kill
spans.anchor: the statue stood leaning toward us, perilously balanced
spans.span: He took his hands away, and the statue stood leaning toward us, perilously balanced.

spans.claim: Salveter wrote a letter in Egyptian hieroglyphs
spans.anchor: I was writing a letter in Egyptian hieroglyphics

spans.claim: The forged letter was torn up and thrown in Bliss’s waste-basket
spans.anchor: I picked up two torn pieces of yellow paper

spans.claim: Scarlett was attacked and hidden in the sarcophagus
spans.anchor: Scarlett’s face was cyanosed, due to insufficient oxygenation
spans.span: Scarlett's face was cyanosed, due to insufficient oxygenation of the blood; his eyes were set in a fixed bulging stare; and there was a crust formation of blood at his nostrils.

spans.claim: Bliss attempted to escape to Canada after the murder
spans.anchor: He drew out everything he had in the bank
spans.span: He drew out everything he had in the bank--got it in twenties, fifties and hundreds--and then took a taxi.

spans.claim: A golden dagger was thrown at Bliss’s bed but missed
spans.anchor: the blade was driven into the headboard just above the pillow

spans.claim: The dagger sheath was found hidden in Salveter’s room
spans.anchor: Here, effendi, is the sheath of the royal dagger

spans.claim: Bliss was killed by the falling statue of Anûbis
spans.anchor: Bliss lay sprawled face downward in a pool of blood
spans.span: In the corner opposite, in almost the exact place where we had found Kyle's body the preceding day, Bliss lay sprawled face downward in a pool of blood.

spans.claim: The statue of Anûbis had broken ankles
spans.anchor: the ankles are very slender, and the statue is made of limestone
spans.span: the ankles are very slender, and the statue is made of limestone--a rather fragile substance.

spans.claim: Hani killed Bliss to end the murderous plot
spans.anchor: He equipped himself with a mace from the museum and struck Bliss

spans.claim: Bliss planted evidence to implicate Salveter
spans.anchor: Bliss put the sheath in Salveter’s room, and then threw the dagger
spans.span: Y' see, Markham, Bliss put the sheath in Salveter's room, and then threw the dagger into the headboard of his bed.

spans.claim: The forged letter was intended to frame Salveter
spans.anchor: the forged letter would, when it appeared, give us evidence against Bliss
spans.span: But since I had the original, I believed that the forged letter would, when it appeared, give us evidence against Bliss.

spans.claim: Vance warned Scarlett to keep away from the Bliss house
spans.anchor: I’d keep away from the Bliss house for the time being
spans.span: And I say, Scarlett; if I were you I'd keep away from the Bliss house for the time being.
